edges.description: The pointer value stored in rr_name after the end-of-iteration free remains unchanged at the next loop-top expansion attempt in the vulnerable version.
When the second iteration expansion fails, the loop-top rr_name value is passed unchanged to the error-path free.

root_cause_criterion.obligation: rr_name == NULL at the start of each loop iteration
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable loop re-enters the next iteration without resetting rr_name to NULL, so a failed name expansion leaves the stale freed pointer live at the error free.
